title: Browser algebraic numbers and advanced exact polynomials
objective: Implement a host-neutral Wasm32-safe QQbar/AA and advanced exact-polynomial resource slice for roots, comparisons, enclosures, signatures, embeddings, and extension-field polynomial resources with Node/Wasm/browser differential and lifecycle tests

oracles: Existing Node QQbar/AA and exact polynomial public tests
FLINT qqbar and polynomial exact arithmetic
exceptions: The mature FLINT qqbar representation and certified enclosures require a compact shared C resource boundary; public policy remains in strict Python

validation: Wasm32 reactor link with pinned FLINT 3.6 under -Wall -Wextra -Werror

handoff.summary: Implemented a host-neutral FLINT qqbar resource core, a flat Wasm32 adapter, and a memory-growth-safe JavaScript owner. The slice supplies exact AA/QQbar arithmetic, ordering, roots with multiplicity, minimal polynomials, certified dyadic enclosures, roots of unity, deterministic serialization, and precision-aware approximation display. Native, real Wasm, and real Chromium tests cover differential semantics, malformed data, generation handles, resource ceilings, memory growth, and leak-free close.
risks: The standalone qqbar closure is 4.8 MiB stripped and 2.0 MiB gzip; integration must measure incremental main-module cost and may prefer a lazy flint-algebraic.wasm artifact.

qqbarApprox supplies certified exact-dyadic midpoint display and explicit double conversion, but arbitrary complex arithmetic requires composition with the analytic Acb backend before that capability is advertised as a complete workflow.
Finite-field fq extension-polynomial resources are a separate generated-FFI closure and are intentionally not falsely reported by this algebraic-number artifact.
Architecture checks cannot pass in this narrow lane until integration classifies the two shared core files and adapter, regenerates the native-export inventory, and adds production receipt evidence.
next_steps: Classify packages/flint/src/algebraic_core.c and .h as accepted external-library-bridge files and packages/flint-wasm/src/algebraic.c as an accepted host-adapter in architecture/native-code.json, then run scripts/audit-native-exports.cjs --write.

Link both C sources into a receipt-bound main or lazy production artifact, export all sagejs_wasm_algebraic_* symbols, package algebraic.mjs, and compose createAlgebraicBackend(instance) into the FLINT backend after the generated/resource backends.

Add aggregate capability algebraic:qqbar-resource-core and bind supported existing qqbar/polyExactRoots NAPI IDs to the artifact receipt; do not mark qqbarMatrix, qqbarMatrixScalarMul, or fq resources available.
Run the two artifact tests with SAGEJS_ALGEBRAIC_WASM pointing to the production artifact and include their Node/Chromium receipts in release validation.
Complete the separate generated fq_context/fq_element/fq_polynomial closure for finite-field extension-polynomial public workflows.
